meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 每次回复前会先调出相关历史记忆，并在每轮对话后把新信息存进记忆。记忆保存在 .claude/ 目录，重启容器后仍在。
howto.when: 当代理容器使用默认 Claude provider 运行对话时，每次回复前会触发记忆召回，回复后触发记忆保存。若 provider 被设为其他值（如 opencode），本技能不生效。

say.text: 请记住我叫小明，最喜欢蓝色。
say.note: Claude 会把这个信息存入长期记忆。

say.text: 上次我说过我家养了只猫，你还记得吗？
say.note: 新会话中问，测试能否自动回忆。

say.text: 以后每周五提醒我开项目例会。
say.note: 让 Claude 把这件事记下来。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude recalls relevant past memories before each response and saves new insights after each turn. Memory is stored in .claude and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: It activates when the agent container runs with the default Claude provider. It triggers memory recall before each reply and saves memory after each turn. It does not run for other providers such as opencode.

say_en.text: Remember that my name is Xiaoming and my favorite color is blue.
say_en.note: Claude will store this in long-term memory.

say_en.text: I mentioned I have a cat last time. Do you remember?
say_en.note: Ask in a new session to test recall.

say_en.text: Remind me to have the weekly project meeting every Friday.
say_en.note: Let Claude keep track of this recurring item.
